name: Medios AG
summary: Medios AG, together with its subsidiaries, supplies specialty pharmaceutical drugs primarily in Germany. It operates through three segments: Patient-Specific Therapies; International Business; and Pharmaceutical Supply. The Patient-Specific Therapies segment manufactures medications for patients on behalf of pharmacies. This segment also includes cytostatic preparations, antibody therapies, and parenteral nutrition solutions. The International Business International covers all activities in the international environment from the procurement of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, the sterile and non-sterile drugs and the supply of public and hospital pharmacies through homecare service.
